response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS above_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY p.rating;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is inclusive: qualifying films have replacement_cost <= 20.99.

Films with a NULL rating are excluded, since they cannot belong to a rating group. Rows with a NULL rental_rate or rental_duration are skipped by AVG. rental_duration is never zero in the data (minimum 3), so the division is safe.
The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the per-rating averages, as the request states. Division is done in DOUBLE to keep the results unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive and keeps only films with replacement_cost strictly less than 20.99.
